title: ToShare
tagline: oshare is a project management platform offering DeFi services through its escrow smart contract, employment tokenization, and efficient communication channels.
description:
Toshare is a comprehensive project management platform that provides a wide range of tools and features for managing projects and teams. The platform offers DeFi services through its escrow smart contract, which holds funds in a secure manner until the project is completed. This ensures that the funds are not released until the project is finished, providing a level of security and transparency.

In addition to its escrow smart contract, Toshare also offers tokenization of employment through Work Reward NFTs. This allows contributors to receive tokens as a form of payment for their work, providing a new and innovative way of compensating team members. The platform also generates custom handles to make communication and collaboration between team members easier and more efficient.

Toshare provides a range of communication channels, including chats, calls, and streaming, to facilitate collaboration between team members. The platform also uses blockchain technology for secure data storage, ensuring that sensitive information is protected. With these features, Toshare provides a comprehensive solution for managing projects and teams in a secure, transparent, and efficient manner.

In conclusion, Toshare is a one-stop-shop for project management, offering DeFi services, employment tokenization, efficient communication channels, and secure data storage, all in one platform. Whether you're a manager, contributor, or team member, Toshare provides the tools and features you need to effectively manage projects and achieve success.
how_its_made:
ToShare utilizes several cutting-edge tools to ensure efficient and secure project management. The platform leverages:
- Filecoin FVM Spaceships for storage solutions, 
- Filecoin DeFi Rockets for escrow smart contracts and payment processing to contributors, as well as tokenizing work, 
- Filecoin Discovery tools for project manager-led work validation, 
- Lighthouse for storing institutional handles that serve as team identity and provide secure handling of sensitive information, 
- Livepeer for live meetings and training within the platform, 
- Huddle01 for voice and video calls, 
- Push Protocol for important messaging and notifications, 
- Spheron Network for storing the platform itself, and 
- Filecoin Docking Modules for file exchange. 
Additionally, ToShare innovates with custom institutional handles and the use of work award NFTs for employment tokenization. Recordings of live calls or streams are automatically stored in a designated folder. Implementing collaborator profiles using NFTs functions as a secure and innovative CV for both the collaborator and project manager.

For the technical backend, ToShare employs Solidity and HardHat while utilizing React, Next.JS, Chakra UI, and TailWi for the frontend development.
